independent_review.text:
# Common physical-subject successor: independent review v2

The bounded main-line physical-membership successor is eligible for composition: `physical-subject-v2.patch` SHA-256 `c2b9224d5d1826012aadd394717ed6ca2045688c25e75c8db236154cd43288aa`, reconstructed from the 53c0 baseline into checker SHA-256 `471524112791dc09480f84d801242b11761985e3c048dd2257b606cb210b75b4`. This qualifies physical subject selection only. It does not close the historical npm profile, Bidi/table source audit, 21.x, G11, security, or release admission.

V2 fixes v1's tampered-profile failure: the exact independent test removes the 23 historical stub rows from a disposable profile; even with zero missing/link markers, `physical_inputs_valid` is now false (`v2/probes.log` SHA-256 `5952939ae62cc824b7cd73d5cf96e3a753515ba27b893b399a75f98be80f96c9`). The successor requires the original profile hash, exact public peer floor, pinned integration proof and its finite 23 removed-path population, current afterimage hashes, and no source/path symlinks before dropping the removed paths. Any failed condition explicitly invalidates the marker, rather than relying on a potentially tampered path list.

All 73 integration proof entries matched the 53c0 Git tree: 50 present afterimages and 23 absences. Their physical current bytes were also rechecked with no mismatches. Independent v2 disposable controls reject symlinks in a deleted-stub ancestor, a current-afterimage ancestor, and the proof file, and pass after restoration. Independent original production report-fidelity suite passed 15 tests in 8.435 seconds; the same run covered missing/wrong export, wrong Bidi, returned stub, wrong peer floor, proof drift, tampered profile, and recovery (`v2/fidelity.log` SHA-256 `b27d454c86cc51e6abd3e73a19dd380660302ba5da8cb0432e66636a5d0be41c`). The actual source fixture advanced from 53c0 to 4066 during the review; those later changes concern the disposition ledger and eight evidence/review files, while the common product afterimages remain exact. Consequently this is not a claim of a complete immutable 53c0 runtime rerun.

The pinned integration source review independently records historical three-argument common-module behavior and its limited packed evidence; separate source diagnostics cover 25 Bidi uses with 49 negative controls and 26 historical table uses with nine negatives, and expressly leave audit closure open. Hashes here bind those reviewed source bytes; they do not establish semantics by themselves. The successor rechecks all 50 integration afterimages (including seven tests) and two additional core files: conservative full-frame provenance, but stricter than physical existence and requiring a reviewed successor on an otherwise unrelated change. The unchanged historical npm validator was separately observed by the owner to fail on its missing typeahead runner input; it is not repaired or relabeled by this patch.

Filesystem walks are not claimed atomic against concurrent external mutation; physical report acquisition still has its own before/after binding. The 21.x branch retains its historical membership route by source inspection; no 21.x execution is claimed. No canonical edits or broad guard changes were made.
